error_generic: Oops, something went wrong on my side. Please try again in a bit 🙏
quota_exceeded: I've hit the AI rate limit 😅 Please wait ~1 minute and try again.
not_authorized: Sorry, this bot is private. Contact the admin if this is a mistake.
start_message:
Hi {name}! 👋

I'm PocketMemo — your personal assistant on Telegram. Just talk to me naturally and I'll figure out what you need.

Here's what I can do:

💾 MEMORY — quick facts
• "I parked at B2 F5" → later ask "where did I park?"

📝 NOTES — titled notes
• "note team meeting: discuss the Q3 roadmap"
• "show my team meeting note" — export to .docx/.txt, attach photos, & OCR handwriting

📂 FILES
• Send a photo/document to store it (I recognize the content) → later "send my ID card"

⏰ REMINDERS
• One-off: "remind me about the meeting at 3pm tomorrow"
• Recurring: "every Monday at 9 remind me about class, 30 minutes before"
• Change it: "move my class to Tuesday at 10"

Type /help for the full command list & examples.
help_message:
PocketMemo — Help 📖

COMMANDS:
/start — intro
/help — this help
/whoami — your account info
/language — switch language (English / Indonesian)
/llm — choose LLM provider, model & API key
/reminders — your reminders
/notes — your notes
/files — your stored files
/memories — your saved facts

OR JUST TYPE NATURALLY — examples:

💾 Memory
• "I parked at B2 F5"  ·  "where did I park?"

📝 Notes
• "note Algorithms class: ..."
• "show my Algorithms class note"
• "add to my Algorithms note: ..."

📂 Files
• send a photo/document  ·  "send my ID card"

⏰ Reminders
• "remind me to take meds at 8"
• "every Monday at 9 remind me about class, 30 minutes before"
• "change the class link to https://..."

💡 Tip: send a photo of handwritten notes → I can attach it to a note and read it into text.
memory_empty: Hmm, I didn't catch what to save. Try writing it again 🙏
memory_recall_what: What would you like me to recall?
memory_recall_none: I don't have any relevant facts saved yet. Save one first and I'll remember 😉
file_unsupported_media: I can't handle this kind of media yet.
file_none: You don't have any saved files yet. Send a photo/document to store one 📎
file_recall_none: I couldn't find a file matching "{query}". Try a different name?
file_physical_missing: The file is in my records but the actual file is missing from storage 😥
file_list_footer: Fetch one with e.g. "send my ID card". Manage/delete via /files.
reminder_parse_fail: I didn't catch the schedule 😅 Try being specific, e.g. "remind me about the meeting at 3pm tomorrow" or "every Monday at 10 remind me about class".
reminder_routine_incomplete: The recurring schedule is incomplete. Tell me the days & time, e.g. "every Tue Thu at 13:00 remind me about Databases class".
reminder_invalid: Hmm, that schedule isn't valid. Please try again.
reminder_onetime_notime: I didn't catch the time. Tell me a date/time, e.g. "3pm tomorrow".
reminder_onetime_badformat: The time wasn't clear. Please try again (e.g. "3pm tomorrow").
reminder_onetime_past: That time has already passed ({time}). Pick a future time.
reminder_none: No active reminders. Create one, e.g. "remind me about the meeting at 3pm tomorrow".
reminder_update_nothing: I didn't catch what to change. Be specific, e.g. "change the link to https://..." or "move it to Tuesday at 10".
reminder_update_no_target: I'm not sure which reminder you mean. Say the name, or use /list then the ✏️ Edit button.
reminder_update_none: No reminders to update yet. Create one first.
note_empty: What should the note be about? Include a title & content 📝
note_recall_what: Which note would you like to open?
note_recall_none: You don't have any saved notes yet. Create one, e.g. "note meeting: ...".
note_recall_no_match: I couldn't find a note matching "{query}". Try /notes to see them all.
note_attach_failed: Couldn't attach (file or note not found).
note_transcribe_filemissing: The image file is missing from storage 😥
note_transcribe_failed: Hmm, I couldn't read any text from that image.
note_transcribe_done: Text from the image was added to the note ✅ Open the note to see it.
note_update_nothing: I didn't catch what to change in the note.
note_update_no_target: I'm not sure which note you mean. Say its title, or open /notes and use ✏️ Edit.
note_update_none: No notes to update yet. Create one first.
note_detached: Attachment '{name}' removed from the note ✅ (the file is kept)
file_save_hint: Want to save a file? Just attach the photo/document 📎
file_save_error: Oops, I couldn't save the file. Please send it again 🙏
note_saved_asfile: Okay, saved as a regular file 📁
note_btn_ocr: ✍️ Read image text into the note
reminder_edit_prompt:
✏️ Edit reminder #{id}. Send the change, e.g:
• change the link to https://...
• move it to Tuesday at 10
• description: Databases lecture 8
• remind 60 minutes before
note_edit_prompt:
✏️ Edit note #{id}. Send the change, e.g:
• title: Algorithms lecture 8
• content: <new text>
• add: <extra text>
intent_unknown: Hmm, I'm not sure what to do with that. Try rephrasing.
note_files_empty: This note has no attachments yet. Send a photo/file, then choose to attach it.
note_list_empty: No notes yet. Create one, e.g. "note today's meeting: ...".
reminder_ask_time: Got it. What time should I remind you? (e.g. "3pm", "tomorrow at 9")
reminder_link_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid link. Send a URL starting with http(s)://.
note_choose_note: Pick a note to attach to:
folder_deleted: Folder '{name}' deleted 🗑️ (its files moved to Uncategorized)
folder_no_folders: You have no folders yet. Open /files and tap ➕ New folder first.
llm_admin_only: LLM settings are admin-only. Set ALLOWED_USER_IDS in .env first.
llm_ask_key: Send your API key. ⚠️ I'll store it encrypted — please delete your message right after.
llm_key_saved: API key saved (encrypted) ✅ Please delete your message above for safety.
memory_list_empty: You haven't saved any facts yet. Just tell me something to remember.
memory_deleted: Memory #{id} deleted 🗑️ Earlier conversation context was also disconnected so I won't remember it from chat history.
